remarks: Located on a quiet street in the sought-after "Cranbury" section of Norwalk, this single-family home offers approximately 2,800 square feet of comfortable living space with a layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The sun-filled main level features a seamless flow between the living and dining areas. Upstairs, the primary suite includes a private full bath, while two additional bedrooms that share a full bath provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or long-term needs. The finished basement adds approximately 1,200 square feet of versatile space-perfect for a media room, gym or playroom. The low-maintenance backyard offers a great setting for outdoor enjoyment. Conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping, dining, and commuter routes. This is a must see!!!
